class.name: EditorFormSection
class.experimental: This editor UI component may change as more editor screens adopt it.
class.brief_description: A titled, optionally collapsible group of editor form rows.
class.description: Combines an [EditorSectionHeader] with a consistently spaced body of [EditorFormRow] controls or custom content.

method.name: add_custom_control
method.description: Adds an arbitrary control to the section body. The section takes ownership of it.

method.name: add_row
method.description: Creates a row with [param label] and optionally assigns [param editor] as its editing control.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all rows and custom controls from the section body.

method.name: get_header
method.description: Returns the section header for badges and trailing actions.

members.member: Whether the section body is hidden.
Whether the header offers a collapse affordance.

signal.name: toggled
signal.description: Emitted when the user changes the section collapse state.
